name: OrbitalMesh
description: Autonomous mesh-network satellites that keep remote operations connected without ground infrastructure.
traction: Three successful high-altitude tests and a signed Arctic logistics pilot.
problem: Remote teams lose critical connectivity when terrestrial networks fail or simply do not exist.
solution: A coordinated fleet of compact satellites routes data dynamically and deploys in months, not years.
businessModel: Annual connectivity contracts plus mission integration fees.
market: $9.8B resilient satellite communications market across logistics, energy, and public safety.
advantage: Flight-tested routing software, modular radios, and a deployment model sized for regional coverage.

name: HelioForge
description: Modular heat batteries that help factories replace natural gas with dispatchable solar energy.
traction: 1.4 MWh pilot operating at a regional food processor.
problem: Industrial heat remains expensive to decarbonize and grid electricity peaks are costly.
solution: Containerized ceramic batteries store low-cost electricity as high-temperature process heat.
businessModel: Equipment lease with a recurring optimization subscription.
market: $20B near-term market for low- and medium-temperature industrial heat.
advantage: Retrofit installation, commodity materials, and proprietary thermal controls.

name: LoomBio
description: Precision-fermented fibers that give apparel brands a durable alternative to petrochemical textiles.
traction: Pilot fiber meets commercial tensile-strength requirements.
problem: Performance textiles rely on fossil inputs and shed persistent microplastics.
solution: Engineered microbes produce spinnable proteins using existing fermentation equipment.
businessModel: Fiber supply agreements and organism licensing.
advantage: Lower-temperature processing and compatibility with existing mills.

name: Fieldnote AI
description: Crop-scouter software that turns phone video into field-level disease and treatment maps.
traction: Used across 42,000 acres during the 2026 growing season.
problem: Disease is usually found after yield damage spreads.
solution: Computer vision identifies early symptoms and maps targeted intervention routes.
market: 6.8M US farms and agronomy service providers.
advantage: Works offline on commodity phones and learns from agronomist verification.

name: RelayHealth
description: A care-navigation layer helping community clinics close referrals before patients fall through gaps.
traction: 89% referral completion across six clinic networks.
problem: Specialty referrals disappear into disconnected systems and manual phone queues.
solution: Relay coordinates eligibility, scheduling, records, and patient follow-up.
businessModel: Clinic platform fee plus completed-referral pricing.
market: $14B US care-coordination software and services market.
advantage: Workflow depth built with safety-net clinics and bilingual patient navigation.

name: Tideframe
description: Street-level flood intelligence for ports, insurers, and coastal public works teams.
traction: Forecasting deployed at two working ports.
problem: Block-level coastal flood risk changes faster than municipal models are updated.
solution: Low-cost sensors and local models create continuously calibrated impact forecasts.
market: 2,000+ coastal cities and commercial ports globally.
advantage: Fast deployment and calibration from sparse sensor networks.

name: FoundryGrid
description: Production scheduling for small manufacturers facing constant changeovers and material delays.
traction: Cuts late jobs by 31% at initial facilities.
problem: Legacy planning systems cannot react to real shop-floor constraints.
solution: Constraint-aware scheduling recalculates production plans from live operator signals.
advantage: Deploys without replacing ERP or machine controls.

name: CivicLedger
description: Cash-flow underwriting for public-benefit contractors waiting months for government payment.
traction: $8.2M in invoices analyzed with zero principal losses.
problem: Reliable contractors face long payment cycles that traditional lenders misunderstand.
solution: Verified contract and invoice data powers transparent working-capital offers.
market: $120B annual US small-business government contracting spend.
advantage: Purpose-built risk model and procurement-system data connectors.

name: QuietRail
description: Active vibration modules that make urban rail quieter without replacing tracks or rolling stock.
traction: 18 dB reduction in a transit-authority bench test.
problem: Rail vibration harms nearby communities and limits overnight service.
solution: Clamp-on sensing and counter-vibration modules suppress targeted frequencies.

name: Northstar Classrooms
description: Work-based learning software connecting high-school projects to local employers and mentors.
problem: Career-connected learning is difficult for schools to coordinate and measure.
solution: A shared project, mentor, and evidence workspace for schools and employers.
market: $4.6B US career and technical education technology market.
advantage: Built around school calendars, safety checks, and competency evidence.

name: EmberWatch
description: Distributed camera intelligence that detects utility-corridor wildfire ignitions in minutes.
traction: 1.2M acres monitored with 94% verified alert precision.
problem: Early wildfire signals are missed across vast, visually complex terrain.
solution: Edge cameras fuse smoke, thermal, and weather cues into operator-ready alerts.
advantage: Field-hardened edge models and utility workflow integration.

name: ParcelKind
description: Reusable shipping systems for independent brands that work with ordinary parcel carriers.
problem: Small ecommerce brands cannot access reusable packaging logistics.
solution: Trackable mailers and pooled reverse logistics fit existing fulfillment workflows.
advantage: Carrier-independent tracking and neighborhood return consolidation.

name: SafeSpan
description: Computer vision that verifies critical construction safety checks without adding paperwork.
traction: 6.3M work hours monitored with a 41% drop in repeat hazards.
problem: Safety observations are inconsistent and too slow to prevent repeat hazards.
solution: Privacy-aware site cameras flag defined risks and close the loop with crews.
advantage: Trade-specific models and worker-centered privacy controls.

name: AeroVault
description: Rapid environmental test chambers for small satellite teams iterating on compressed schedules.
traction: Completed 37 thermal-vacuum campaigns with 96% on-time delivery.
problem: Small space teams wait months for thermal-vacuum testing.
solution: Standardized compact chambers and automated test reporting reduce queue time.
businessModel: Per-test service plus annual priority access.
advantage: Purpose-built smallsat workflow and fast repeatable fixtures.

name: Morrow Water
description: Modular treatment skids that remove difficult industrial contaminants at the source.
problem: Industrial wastewater is costly to haul and difficult to treat with fixed plants.
solution: Adaptive electrochemical skids treat variable streams on site.
businessModel: Equipment lease priced per gallon treated.
market: $12B industrial water treatment equipment and services.
advantage: Modular deployment and controls tuned to changing waste streams.
